item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your calendar is full of reminders about perspective, patterns, and whether a moment supports the life you want. Good. But reminders only work if you answer them. Notice when an old story starts running, especially assumptions about what others are thinking. Ask whether it's fact or projection. Then choose the response that fits your values. Action: at your next reminder, stop and answer the question in one honest sentence.
